summary.title: Atlassian Team Playbook
summary.one_liner: A free library of workshop-style "Plays" (OKRs, DACI, retrospectives, working agreements and more) for tackling common team challenges.
keywords: how do i run a team retrospective
how to make decisions as a team
takeaways: Plays are free, step-by-step workshop resources for common team challenges such as goal setting, decision-making and meetings.
The DACI framework assigns clear roles to make decisions and keep accountability during collaboration.
OKRs define objectives and track progress with measurable key results.
Retrospectives give teams a safe space to discuss what worked and what did not.
Use the Play recommendation quiz to find a suitable Play by category.
summary.summary: The Atlassian Team Playbook is a web catalog of free workshop-style "Plays" grouped by category, including goal-setting (OKRs), decision-making (DACI, Tradeoffs), project planning (Project Poster, Network of Teams, Project Kick-Off), productivity (Working Agreements), meetings (Weekly Team Updates, Page-Led Meetings), communication (User Manual) and debrief (Retrospective). Each Play is described briefly, and the page explains a workflow of finding, trying and running a Play, with a recommendation quiz to help choose one. The page cites some productivity figures attributed to Lievens & Sackett (2017) and the Atlassian Teamwork Lab, but gives no detail on the underlying studies. Listed under 'Handbooks' in kuchin/awesome-cto.
